body:
There are two aspects to this. First of all, the default values returned by GDScripts impl of `get_property_default_value` are shared with the actual values of the instance. Which means when appending to the array, the values are also appended to the default value. So other parts of the engine think there is no need to store this.

Now this in theory shouldn't be an issue since the MRP also calls `counted_ints = []` which should in theory "de-link" the instance value from the default value. This however does not work due to a second issue: The implementation of `PlaceHolderScriptInstance::set` does do a simple `Variant::OP_NOT_EQUAL` compare to decide whether to store the value. For arrays this does a hash compare so the new value won't be stored. While a hash compare is fine to decide whether to serialize something, in `PlaceHolderScriptInstance` which might be used by code, we should be doing an identity compare for shared variant types.
